+"""Regression test: SQL role grants survive gbak backup and restore."""
+import json
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import tempfile
+import uuid
+
+
+def run(argv, sql=None, timeout=180):
+    return subprocess.run(
+        argv,
+        input=sql,
+        text=True,
+        capture_output=True,
+        timeout=timeout,
+        check=False,
+    )
+
+
+def main():
+    dsn = os.environ.get("ACREPAIR_FIREBIRD_DSN")
+    if not dsn:
+        raise RuntimeError("ACREPAIR_FIREBIRD_DSN is required")
+
+    isql = os.environ.get("ACREPAIR_ISQL", "isql")
+    gbak = os.environ.get("ACREPAIR_GBAK", "gbak")
+    admin = os.environ.get("ACREPAIR_ADMIN_USER", "SYSDBA")
+    password = os.environ.get("ACREPAIR_PASSWORD_" + admin.upper(), "masterkey")
+    suffix = uuid.uuid4().hex[:10].upper()
+    user = "AC_RESTORE_USER_" + suffix
+    user_password = "restore_" + suffix.lower()
+    role = "AC_RESTORE_ROLE_" + suffix
+    table = "AC_RESTORE_TABLE_" + suffix
+    setup_sql = (
+        f"CREATE USER {user} PASSWORD '{user_password}';\n"
+        f"CREATE TABLE {table} (ID INTEGER);\n"
+        f"INSERT INTO {table} VALUES (7);\n"
+        f"CREATE ROLE {role};\n"
+        f"GRANT SELECT ON {table} TO {role};\n"
+        f"GRANT {role} TO {user};\n"
+        "COMMIT;\n"
+    )
+
+    admin_cmd = [isql, "-user", admin, "-password", password, dsn]
+    setup = run(admin_cmd, "SET BAIL ON;\n" + setup_sql)
+    if setup.returncode != 0:
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            "Could not create the role privilege fixture: "
+            + setup.stdout
+            + setup.stderr
+        )
+
+    try:
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="acrepair-firebird-role-restore-") as tmp:
+            backup_file = str(Path(tmp) / "role_privileges.fbk")
+            restored_db = str(Path(tmp) / "restored.fdb")
+
+            backup = run(
+                [gbak, "-b", "-user", admin, "-password", password, dsn, backup_file]
+            )
+            if backup.returncode != 0:
+                raise RuntimeError(
+                    "gbak backup failed: " + backup.stdout + backup.stderr
+                )
+
+            restore = run(
+                [
+                    gbak,
+                    "-c",
+                    "-user",
+                    admin,
+                    "-password",
+                    password,
+                    backup_file,
+                    restored_db,
+                ]
+            )
+            if restore.returncode != 0:
+                raise RuntimeError(
+                    "gbak restore failed: " + restore.stdout + restore.stderr
+                )
+
+            target = run(
+                [
+                    isql,
+                    "-user",
+                    user,
+                    "-password",
+                    user_password,
+                    "-role",
+                    role,
+                    restored_db,
+                ],
+                "SET BAIL ON;\n"
+                + f"SELECT CURRENT_ROLE, ID FROM {table};\n",
+            )
+            passed = target.returncode == 0
+            result = {
+                "checks": [
+                    {
+                        "name": "role_granted_table_privilege_survives_gbak_restore",
+                        "kind": "target",
+                        "passed": passed,
+                        "expected": {"success": True},
+                        "actual": {
+                            "returncode": target.returncode,
+                            "stdout": target.stdout,
+                            "stderr": target.stderr,
+                        },
+                    }
+                ],
+                "reproduced": not passed,
+                "origin": "generated_from_fix_description_and_role_privilege_contract",
+            }
+            print("CHECK_RESULT=" + json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False), flush=True)
+    finally:
+        # Cleanup is best-effort so a failed target assertion does not mask its result.
+        cleanup_sql = (
+            "SET BAIL OFF;\n"
+            f"REVOKE {role} FROM {user};\n"
+            f"REVOKE SELECT ON {table} FROM {role};\n"
+            f"DROP ROLE {role};\n"
+            f"DROP TABLE {table};\n"
+            f"DROP USER {user};\n"
+            "COMMIT;\n"
+        )
+        run(admin_cmd, cleanup_sql, timeout=60)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    try:
+        main()
+    except (OSError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired, RuntimeError) as exc:
+        print("TEST_INFRA_ERROR=" + str(exc), file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
+        sys.exit(2)
